up.query: CREATE TABLE "organization_invites" ("id" uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), "created_at" TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), "updated_at" TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), "deleted_at" TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, "organization_id" uuid NOT NULL, "email" character varying(300) NOT NULL, "role_id" "public"."role_name" NOT NULL, "scope_type" "public"."role_scope" NOT NULL, "scope_id" uuid NOT NULL, "property_id" uuid, "token_hash" character varying(64) NOT NULL, "status" "public"."invite_status" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', "expires_at" TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, "invited_by" uuid NOT NULL, "locale" character varying(2) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "CHK_f29f21c85798427a7ddb6dae13" CHECK ((scope_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND scope_id = organization_id AND property_id IS NULL) OR (scope_type = 'PROPERTY' AND property_id IS NOT NULL AND property_id = scope_id)), CONSTRAINT "PK_e0799bee14bf23b82851d55fd05" PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "IDX_af80ebe49b61d1cd55ea622150" ON "organization_invites"  ("organization_id", "email") WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE "property_configs" ("id" uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), "created_at" TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), "updated_at" TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), "deleted_at" TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, "organization_id" uuid NOT NULL, "property_id" uuid NOT NULL, "configuration" jsonb NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "UQ_88ffcbc0052b50eb7103dcd1720" UNIQUE ("organization_id", "property_id"), CONSTRAINT "PK_69aa5377891bbbf8e5f46a7646e" PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "properties" ("id" uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), "created_at" TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), "updated_at" TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), "deleted_at" TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, "organization_id" uuid NOT NULL, "name" character varying(200) NOT NULL, "type" "public"."property_type" NOT NULL, "address_line1" character varying(300) NOT NULL, "address_line2" character varying(300), "city" character varying(120) NOT NULL, "state" character varying(120) NOT NULL, "postal_code" character varying(20) NOT NULL, "country" character varying(2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'IN', "timezone" character varying(100), "status" "public"."property_status" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE', CONSTRAINT "UQ_a070477969fdc2ecb68ce179608" UNIQUE ("organization_id", "id"), CONSTRAINT "PK_2d83bfa0b9fcd45dee1785af44d" PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

ALTER TABLE "user_role_assignments" ADD CONSTRAINT "CHK_af3675a93d4cc6022d83de0564" CHECK ((scope = 'ORGANIZATION' AND scope_id = organization_id AND property_id IS NULL) OR (scope = 'PROPERTY' AND property_id IS NOT NULL AND property_id = scope_id))

ALTER TABLE "user_role_assignments" ADD CONSTRAINT "FK_614b91c402bbee62750d770aed4" FOREIGN KEY ("property_id", "organization_id") REFERENCES "properties"("id","organization_id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE NO ACTION

ALTER TABLE "organization_invites" ADD CONSTRAINT "FK_b32d074bcac0fe8b8527ca27e74" FOREIGN KEY ("invited_by", "organization_id") REFERENCES "users"("id","organization_id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE NO ACTION
ALTER TABLE "organization_invites" ADD CONSTRAINT "FK_01ecac90a28de2561019b9cad2a" FOREIGN KEY ("role_id") REFERENCES "roles"("name") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE NO ACTION

ALTER TABLE "organization_invites" ADD CONSTRAINT "FK_ba0269236596ec5872c3ef9f507" FOREIGN KEY ("property_id", "organization_id") REFERENCES "properties"("id","organization_id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE NO ACTION

ALTER TABLE "property_configs" ADD CONSTRAINT "FK_88ffcbc0052b50eb7103dcd1720" FOREIGN KEY ("property_id", "organization_id") REFERENCES "properties"("id","organization_id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE NO ACTION
ALTER TABLE "properties" ADD CONSTRAINT "FK_6a3c051a6826225fba2aa24dd50" FOREIGN KEY ("organization_id") REFERENCES "organizations"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE NO ACTION
